summary: Applied the user's corrected target: BB's global Host Monitor icon remains neutral and dot-free, while Healthy/Attention/Critical chips in the Host Monitor page's inner fleet sidebar now use restrained semantic border/background/text colors and disconnected/offline/unavailable states remain muted. Superseded the rejected icon-tint and orb-only decisions, added closed neutral normalization for unknown status/sample/health plus visible label fallbacks, expanded focused regressions, and passed Host Monitor 150/150 tests, typecheck, and direct oxlint. Live computed styles and a corrected screenshot confirm the inner chips and neutral global icon.

Preserve visible text and accessible state labels so color is never the only signal. Add focused regression coverage, bump Host Monitor from 0.1.1 to 0.1.2 across active manifest/lock/documentation/distribution contracts, run focused and root checks, keep the local watcher/install live, and verify the real BB UI with a screenshot. Do not commit, push, tag, publish, release, or update the marketplace.
